features.lead: We take care of the technology – you enjoy a safe, well-thought-out home.

items.title: No open ports on your router
items.desc: Remote access runs through an encrypted tunnel instead of port forwarding, so your home has no open door on the internet – and Home Assistant stays protected by its own login.

items.title: You decide who gets in and when
items.desc: The technician can't just walk in. Only you open access with a tap – and only you close it. Like an intercom: you see who's ringing and open the door yourself.

items.title: Automations without programming
items.desc: Lights turn off when you leave. Heating follows a schedule. We set up the scenes for you – no technical knowledge needed on your side.

items.title: Spot problems early
items.desc: Our monitoring reports when your system is no longer reachable – often before you notice. Depending on your plan, we take care of it promptly.

items.title: Control from anywhere
items.desc: With the Home Assistant app on your phone, tablet or PC: check the status, switch lights, check the lock – even on the go.

items.title: Neutral advice, real people
items.desc: We don't earn money on devices, so we recommend what suits you. Our technicians handle setup, updates and help themselves – no chatbots.

howItWorks.h2: Four steps to your smart home
howItWorks.lead: You pay us for consulting, setup and support – not for hardware. That keeps our recommendations neutral.

steps.title: Consultation & shopping list
steps.desc: We go through your rooms, budget and wishes – lighting, climate, security, energy. You get a shopping list with specific, compatible models and links to retailers.

steps.title: You buy the devices
steps.desc: You order directly from retailers such as Amazon or IKEA – in your name, at their prices. Warranty and returns are handled directly by the retailer.

steps.title: On-site setup
steps.desc: We install the devices, set up Home Assistant, the Zigbee network and your automations, and walk you through everything. You also get a short PDF guide.
steps.note: About 3–7 hours, depending on the home

steps.title: Support subscription
steps.desc: We monitor availability, apply security updates and help when something doesn't work. We only access your system when you allow it.

security.lead: We built the system so you are always in charge – even when you use our support.

pillars.title: Encrypted – without port forwarding
pillars.desc: Your smart home establishes the connection itself through an encrypted tunnel (TLS) – no port forwarding on your router is needed. Access from outside is additionally protected by the Home Assistant login.
pillars.label: No open ports

pillars.title: Technician enters only on your invitation
pillars.desc: Without your explicit approval we technically cannot connect. You press «Allow» – the technician is in. You press «Disconnect» – they're gone. Every session is logged.
pillars.label: Full control is yours

pillars.title: Your data stays on your hardware
pillars.desc: Devices, automations and history are stored on your own hardware. Only technical metrics and device status – such as a sensor going unresponsive – reach our platform. We don't store passwords, camera images or detailed usage history.
pillars.label: GDPR · Data stays with you

items.q: Do I have to buy the devices from you?
items.a: No – we don't sell devices. You get a shopping list with suitable models from us and buy directly from the retailer. We're happy to include devices you already own, as long as they're compatible with Home Assistant.

You pay us for consulting, setup and support – you buy the devices directly from the retailer. The cost depends on the size of your home and your wishes. In the free initial call we give you a fixed price for our work and an estimate for the devices. No hidden costs.

items.q: Who is responsible if a device is faulty?
items.a: The warranty and guarantee of the retailer or manufacturer you bought from apply to the devices. We help you identify the fault and prepare the claim. For our own work – installation and setup – we're responsible ourselves.

items.q: Can technicians monitor me without my knowledge?
items.a: No. A staff member only gets access after you actively approve it, and loses it as soon as you switch it off. Every access session is recorded in a tamper-evident log that you can view in your account at any time.

items.q: Will my personal data end up on some server?
items.a: Your smart home data – devices, automations, history – stays on your hardware, in your home network. Only technical metrics and device status, plus the commands you trigger yourself, are sent to our platform. We don't store passwords, camera images or detailed usage history.

items.q: Do I need to know anything about technology?
items.a: Not at all. All you need is internet at home and the wish for a smart home. We work out together which devices fit – installation, setup and updates are on us.

items.q: What is Home Assistant and why do I need it?
items.a: Home Assistant is a free, brand-independent smart home system trusted by hundreds of thousands of users worldwide. It brings devices from different brands together in one place and runs locally at your home. We install and configure it – you don't need to know how it works under the hood.

items.q: What if I want to cancel?
items.a: Support can be cancelled with 30 days’ notice to the end of a month. Your devices are yours anyway, Home Assistant keeps running and your data stays with you. We simply disconnect the Tinta Agent – without any data loss.
